missed.part: 74HC4538PW,118 (LCSC C547076); 74HC4538PW-Q100 (C3241572); CD74HC4538PWR (C354056) as its alternate in the same land
missed.why: P2 has no record of the 74HC4538 family from Nexperia or TI. It records only onsemi's MC74HC4538A, which is discontinued. This overturns the claim in rank 1's reason that the 74HC423BQ is 'the only part read' with the '423 behaviour, stock above the gate and characterization that brackets 3.3 V. Sources: Nexperia 74HC4538 Rev. 7 (26 March 2024), https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/74HC4538.pdf, read 2026-09-29T05:08:01Z. TI SCHS123E (revised October 2003), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/cd74hc4538.pdf, read 05:07:51Z. The part against each value: (1) '423 behaviour. Nexperia Table 3 has three rows: nA falling with nB L gives a pulse; nA H with nB rising gives a pulse; nCD L gives nQ L. TI's truth table is the same. Neither has a row that fires a pulse when nCD rises. TI states 'On power up the IC is reset', and Nexperia's logic diagram (Fig. 2) draws a power-on reset block. Neither text has an explicit sentence such as the 74HC423's 'cannot be triggered via the reset input'. The behaviour is read from the function table alone, one of the two grounds the FU-A2 adjudicator accepted for the 74HC423. Unlike the 74HC423's Fig. 9, no figure contradicts it. P4 or the owner decides whether that counts as 'stated'. (2) Dual retriggerable: each half has a rising-edge and a falling-edge input. Pins 4 and 12 are rising-edge and pins 5 and 11 falling-edge on both makers' pinouts, so the TI part fits the Nexperia land pin for pin. (3) Supply: 2.0 V to 6.0 V. (4) Isolation: 'Inputs include clamp diodes', so there is no I_off. Like rank 1, it takes the Q9 buffer. (5) Q low while clear is active: stated in the function table. (6) R: REXT 10 kOhm to 1000 kOhm at VCC 2.0 V and 2 kOhm to 1000 kOhm at 5.0 V (Nexperia Table 7); RMIN 5 kOhm (TI). (7) C: 'no limits' (Nexperia); CMIN 0 (TI). tW = 0.7 x R x C, so 170 ms takes 1.62 uF at 150 kOhm to 4.86 uF at 50 kOhm (derived); P2's 2.37 uF to 7.1 uF is the 74HC423 range. (8) V36: TI states the output pulse width at VCC 3 V, RX 10 kOhm, CX 0.1 uF: 0.64 ms to 0.78 ms at 25 degC and 0.612 ms to 0.812 ms at -40 to 85 degC. That is a limit at 3 V over temperature, which no part P2 read states, but it is at another R and C. Nexperia graphs K typical against VCC (Figs. 14 and 15, 25 degC) and against temperature (Figs. 16 and 17, 4.5 V, CEXT 1 nF and 1 uF). No curve lies between 5.6 kOhm and 1 MOhm, so the temperature term at 3.3 V and 50 kOhm to 150 kOhm is not stated. (9) V37: nREXT/CEXT leakage is +/-50 nA at 25 degC and +/-500 nA at -40 to 85 degC (Nexperia, VCC 6.0 V). TI gives +/-0.05 uA and +/-0.5 uA. Doubled every 10 degC to 50 degC, that is 0.28 uA, half the 0.57 uA P2 books for the 74HC423. (10) Trigger high level: VIH 1.5 V at 2.0 V and 3.15 V at 4.5 V, with no 3.3 V row. These are the same bracketing columns P2 accepted for the 74HC423. Nexperia also claims JESD8C (2.7 V to 3.6 V). TI gives the A and B trigger rise and fall time as 'Unlimited' at every VCC (Schmitt inputs). The reset input is limited to 1000 ns at 2 V and 500 ns at 4.5 V, the same kind of limit P2 notes for the 74HC423's nRD. (11) Temperature: -40 to 125 degC. Section 11.1 calls for a damping diode DEXT across a large CEXT, the same point as the 74HC423's section 11.3. Stock, vendors.py jlcpcb exact matches (stockCount/canPresaleNumber, gate 50): C547076 8953/8951, C3241572 2314/2314, C354056 934/925, C2652503 (CD74HC4538QM96G4Q1, SOIC) 433/433, all read 2026-09-29T05:07:52Z; C2652500 (CD74HC4538NSR) 20/20, 05:07:53Z. Digi-Key: 74HC4538PW,118, Nexperia USA Inc., Active, stock_available 4779, lead 20 weeks; the NXP USA Inc. row is 'Discontinued at DigiKey' with 0 (vendors.py digikey, 05:10:57Z). CD74HC4538PWR, Texas Instruments, Active, 7021, lead 9 weeks (05:10:59Z). Lifecycle: https://www.nexperia.com/product/74HC4538PW shows 'Production' (product-status--production in the page body), read 05:10:15Z. https://www.ti.com/product/CD74HC4538 has meta status ACTIVE. But the CD74HC4538PWR orderable's marketingStatusLongDesc reads 'This product is available for existing designs. However, for new designs, we recommend considering an alternate.' (05:10:16Z). That is TI's own wording, not a status value the gate names; it is recorded for the owner. Toshiba TC74HC4538AF(EL,F) (C5381650, 835/835, 05:07:53Z) is a third maker. Its datasheet (https://toshiba.semicon-storage.com/info/docget.jsp?did=16381&prodName=TC74HC4538AF, read 05:09:30Z) says 'If CD is low, a trigger has no effect ... if CD input is set low, the IC goes into a wait state'. It states that DX is not needed when the supply fall time tf >= (VCC - 0.7) x CX / 20 mA. But its T2 terminal leakage is +/-0.5 uA at 25 degC and +/-5.0 uA at -40 to 85 degC: 2.83 uA at 50 degC by the V37 method. Scaled from P2's 1.85 % for 0.57 uA, that is about 9 %, more than the window's +/-8.8 % alone (derived), so it fails 'window at every corner'. Its product page body carries no status (read 05:09:01Z): not read. Digi-Key was not read for it.

P2 has no record of the TPS385x supervisors, whose threshold accuracy is 0.8 %. Source: SBVS302 (November 2016), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3852.pdf, read 2026-09-29T05:12:15Z. Table 5: H means VITN = -7 % of the 3.3 V nominal, 3.069 V. Section 6.5: VITN accuracy +/-0.8 % at -40 to 125 degC, so 3.0445 V to 3.0936 V. VHYST (VDD rising) is 0.2 % min, 0.5 % typ and 0.8 % max. So the release is at most 3.0936 x 1.008 = 3.118 V, below 3.201 V. The band to 3.201 V is 156.5 mV, 1.5 mV wider than rank 1's 155 mV and narrower than TPS3808G33 (169 mV) and TLV809EA30 (183 mV). The threshold minimum is above 2.0 V, 1.65 V and 0.8 V. tRST is 170 ms to 230 ms, which meets V43's 125 ns. VDD is 1.6 V to 6.5 V. RESET is driven low below UVLO (1.35 V typ). VPOR is 0.8 V max. The output is open-drain, as rank 1's is. Grounding SET1 disables the window watchdog (section 7.3), and WDI is then tied to GND or VDD. The G33 option fails the release rule: 3.168 x 1.008 x 1.008 = 3.219 V > 3.201 V. JLCPCB C2066812: stockCount 4321, canPresaleNumber 4236 (05:12:45Z, vendors.py jlcpcb). Rank 1 C1849519 has 307/305 (05:14:53Z). Digi-Key TPS3852H33DRBR: Texas Instruments, Active, stock_available 0, lead 16 weeks (vendors.py digikey, 05:13:10Z). The TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TPS3852 has status ACTIVE, and the orderable's text reads 'released to the market and is available for purchase' (05:13:08Z). The package is SON-8 3 x 3 mm, not rank 1's WSON-6 land, so it is a candidate with 14 times rank 1's JLCPCB stock, not a rule-5 alternate in one land. The TPS3850H33 (VSON-10, C2067319 774/768 at 05:12:46Z) monitors a SENSE pin; its figures are not read here.

missed.part: VN7016AJ, VN7004CH, VN7007AH (VIPower M0-7 high-side drivers)
missed.why: P2 has no record of ST's single-channel smart high-side drivers, which the parts database lists in stock (VN7004CHTR C2150194, VN7007AHTR C2150197). They do not qualify on the data sheets. Sources: VN7016AJ DocID027399 Rev 1, https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/vn7016aj.pdf, read 2026-09-29T05:14:00Z; VN7004CH DocID027769 Rev 6, read 05:14:02Z; VN7007AH DocID027957 Rev 3, read 05:14:04Z. Operating VCC is 4 V to 28 V. VUSD is 4 V max, VUSDReset 5 V max, and VUSDhyst 0.3 V typical with no maximum. The truth table restores the output at 'VCC > VUSD + VUSDhyst'. So closing and conducting on a rail that rises to 4.8 V is not shown, which fails 'lowest conducting rail voltage (V55)'. IOUT is 'Internally limited', with no continuous current stated, so 'continuous current' (at least 6.35 A) is not shown either. They state IL(off) 0.5 uA max at 25 degC and 3 uA at 125 degC (VCC 13 V), and td(off) 100 us max (VN7016AJ). JLCPCB and Digi-Key were not read, because two values fail.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: not qualified: no Schmitt input on a line behind 4.7 kOhm and 100 kOhm
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The reason names none of the four requirement values P2 lists for this function (I_off on the input, input threshold, supply, ambient temperature), and both parts meet all four. The FU-A2 P3 raised this, and P2's list is still unchanged. SCES214AF (revised October 2025, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g04.pdf, read 2026-09-29T05:19:51Z) gives Ioff +/-10 uA at VI or VO 5.5 V with VCC 0 V, and VIH 2.0 V min at 3 V to 3.6 V. The drop holds only on a value P2 has not written: section 5.3 limits delta-t/delta-V to 10 ns/V at VCC 3.3 V +/-0.3 V. Behind 4.7 kOhm the input's own Ci of 3.5 pF typical gives 2.2 x 4.7 kOhm x 3.5 pF = 36 ns for 10 % to 90 % of 3.3 V, about 13.7 ns/V. That is derived from a typical Ci with no board capacitance, and it exceeds 10 ns/V. P2 adds 'input transition rate behind 4.7 kOhm' to the function and cites that limit. The same unwritten value is why every latch 'takes the Schmitt buffer ahead of CP'.
